name: adversarial-multimodel-review
description: Always-on deep, full-context adversarial review. Coordinates independent critic subagents requesting different models to verify agent work before commit or deployment. The parent agent writes a structured evidence packet to `.adversarial-review/` (user intent quotes, rejected approaches, accepted plan, diff, tests) that critics MUST read before producing findings, since Cursor subagents cannot see parent chat history.
